verdict: Meta is driving all leads; Google spend needs rebalancing now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 30 leads at $133.98 cost per lead — all 30 came from Meta, which spent $1,604.74 to deliver them. Google Ads consumed $2,414.68 over the same period and returned only 2 conversions, a clear imbalance that is being addressed by rebalancing spend toward what is working. The most recent week shows positive movement — leads are up 25% and cost per lead is down 10% compared to the prior week — though one strong day accounts for much of that lift, so we're watching to see if it holds. Your Google Business Profile recorded zero actions on the last three days of the period, which points to a drop in local search visibility; we're investigating and will have a clearer picture next week.
